mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and metabolic abnormalities may be potentiated by atazanavir's effects on electrolyte balance; additionally, thiazide diuretics can increase serum uric acid and glucose levels which may complicate antiretroviral therapy management.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium), glucose, and uric acid levels regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive agents if electrolyte disturbances develop; ensure adequate potassium supplementation or concurrent use of potassium-sparing agents if interaction unavoidable.
